title: The Rate an Auto Loan Carries After Its Standing Draft Instruction Changes
content:
The rate restated on a loan of the Auto Loans line when the standing draft instruction changes is the rate recorded on the loan raised by the reduction restored, raised again by the arrears adjustment and by the manual-payment step, then reduced by the standing deposit allowance, and rounded last. The restated rate never falls below the floor rate the product publishes.

The rate restated on such a loan when the standing draft instruction changes is written to the loan on the day the instruction changes, and interest accrues at it from that day.

The reduction restored is the automatic-payment reduction the product publishes. The arrears adjustment is the full 0.5 points. The manual-payment step is 0.1 points. The standing deposit allowance set against the raised rate is 0.00. The restated rate is rounded half-up to the cent.

## In what order the quantities act

The three raises act on the rate recorded on the loan together, and the allowance is taken off the figure they produce, not off the recorded rate. The floor is applied to the figure after the allowance. The rounding is applied last of all, to the figure the floor leaves.

## An illustration on hypothetical readings

Take a loan whose recorded rate is 7.99 percent, on a product publishing an automatic-payment reduction of 0.25 percentage points and a floor rate of 4.49 percent.

The reduction restored is 0.25, the arrears adjustment 0.5 and the manual-payment step 0.1, so the raised rate is 7.99 together with those three, which is 8.84.

The standing deposit allowance is 0.00, so the figure after the allowance is 8.84. That figure is above the floor of 4.49, so the floor leaves it where it is.

Rounded half-up to the cent, the rate restated on the loan is 8.84 percent.

## Where the floor binds

Take instead a loan whose recorded rate is 3.20 percent on a product publishing a floor rate of 4.49 percent, with the same three raises and the same allowance of 0.00. The raised rate is 4.05, which is below the floor, so the figure after the allowance is 4.49, and the restated rate is 4.49 percent.
